stories.narrEs: Según AM Prensa, la mandataria calificó el homicidio como una “mancha contra la libertad de expresión” e instruyó a los cuerpos policiales a colaborar con la investigación para identificar a los responsables. De acuerdo con El Financiero (Costa Rica), el periodista Camilo Rodríguez Chaverri fue asesinado la tarde de este lunes 16 de noviembre. Según Infobae, el comunicador fue atacado mientras viajaba en su vehículo por Santo Domingo de Heredia. De acuerdo con ABC Color (Paraguay), el Organismo de Investigación Judicial (OIJ) informó que el caso se encuentra en investigación para tratar de dar con los responsables del crimen.
stories.narrEn: The Tico Times reports: Journalist Camilo Rodríguez was shot dead on Route 32 in Heredia. Le Monde reports: Camilo Rodriguez, an independent journalist who had linked drug traffickers to politicians, was killed outside the capital as Costa Rica struggles with a surge in organized crime. The Tico Times reports: Prosecutors are examining earlier death threats in the third killing of a journalist in Costa Rica.

China and Canada Expand Tariff Relief as Xi Meets Carney

Canada and China extend trade deals as Xi meets Carney ahead of APEC summit

stories.narrEn: Bloomberg reports: China and Canada agreed to further tariff relief on agriculture and steel exports as President Xi Jinping and Prime Minister Mark Carney met in Shenzhen on Tuesday. CNA reports: Beijing will provide additional tariff relief for around US$280 million in Canadian exports, while Ottawa has agreed to extend by two years existing remission measures for certain Chinese steel and aluminium products. The Straits Times reports: A major plank of Carney’s economic strategy is to reduce Canada’s heavy reliance on the United States.
